اختمرن (form VIII)
# اِخْتَمَرْنَ (iḵtamarna) /ix.ta.mar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَمَرَ (iḵtamara)
# اِخْتَمِرْنَ (iḵtamirna) /ix.ta.mir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْتَمَرَ (iḵtamara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
